title: Telemetry message on fleet/{vehicle_id}/telemetry
description: Sent by the CloudPublisher (vehicle/cloud_publisher/main.py, Bridge.snapshot) once per second. Shape only: the quality rules (ranges, lateness) are in cloud/quality.py. Values can be null until the twin has every signal. Spec REQ-007.

route_id.description: Route the van drives, for example B

trip_id.description: Goes up by one each time the van passes the depot

ts_ms.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the message was sent

hazard.description: Current hazard type, or null when there is none
